title: DNA Extraction Protocol for Animal Blood Samples Using E.Z.N.A. Blood Mini Kit
author: Louis-Stéphane Le Clercq
materials: Discard the filtrate and reuse Collection Tube.
Discard the filtrate and reuse the Collection Tube.
Optional: Apply filtrate to column and repeat centrifugation.

steps.title: Transfer sample and adjust volume
steps.instruction: Transfer the animal blood sample into a sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and bring the total volume to 250 µL using 10 mM Tris‑HCl, PBS, or the supplied Elution Buffer.

steps.title: Add ethanol and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 260 µL of 100 % ethanol to the tube and vortex at maximum speed for 20 seconds.

steps.title: Insert HiBind column
steps.instruction: Insert a provided HiBind DNA Mini Column (green) into a 2 mL clear collection tube; label the cap as needed.

steps.title: Add DNA Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of DNA Wash Buffer (pre‑diluted with 100 % ethanol as instructed by the kit) to the column.

steps.title: Dry column membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty HiBind DNA Mini Column at 13 000 × g, 21 °C for 2 minutes to dry the membrane and remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Transfer column to nuclease‑free tube
steps.instruction: Move the HiBind DNA Mini Column into a nuclease‑free 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL Proteinase K solution (provided), 250 µL BL Buffer (provided), and 5 µL RNase I (25 000 U, NEB Cat #M0243L, 50 mg/mL) to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex lysate
steps.instruction: Vortex at maximum speed for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate for protein digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 10 minutes in a heating block set to 65 °C; vortex briefly once during the incubation.

steps.title: Collect condensation drops
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tube to collect any drops that have formed on the inside of the lid.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire lysate to the HiBind DNA Mini Column and centrifuge at 11 000 × g, 21 °C for 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash with HBC Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL HBC Buffer (pre‑diluted with 100 % isopropanol as instructed), discard the filtrate and the used collection tube, then insert the column into a new 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Remove residual wash buffer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 11 000 × g, 21 °C for 1 minute, then centrifuge again at 10 000 × g, 21 °C for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Elution Buffer pre‑heated to 65 °C to the column.

steps.title: Incubate and collect eluate
steps.instruction: Incubate the column at 65 °C for 5 minutes, then centrifuge at 13 000 × g, 21 °C for 2 minutes to collect the eluted DNA.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Store the eluted DNA at –20 °C until further use.
